paper_ready_statements: The anger bias is statistically significant (χ²(1) = 1461.78, p < .001, Cramér's V = 0.831).
Scenario-level correlation between human agreement and LLM accuracy: r = -0.32, p = 0.603.
Inter-annotator reliability varied by subtype: deflection-misdirection showed lowest agreement (κ = 0.18), while passive-aggression showed highest (κ = 0.42).
